# BrightLink Consulting

## What is BrightLink Consulting?
BrightLink Consulting is a consulting firm founded by Mike Walker that designs online learning environments, government training programs, and digital ecosystems for public sector organizations and subject matter experts.

## Founder
Mike Walker — 30+ years building systems, programs, and infrastructure across government, education, consulting, and digital products. Founder of Walker Surfboards (1996), BrightLink Consulting, and ClientBloom.ai.

## Two Core Services

### 1. Public Sector & Government (brightlinkconsulting.com/public)
BrightLink designs SCORM-compliant, Section 508 accessible online training programs and operational systems for:
- Federal agencies (GSA, SBA, HHS, DoD sub-contractors)
- State and local government
- SBDC and WBC networks (SBA-funded)
- Defense and government contractors
- Federally-funded healthcare and workforce development programs

**Credentials:** SAM.gov Registered | CAGE Code: 1A8D6 | UEI: HPP7BBEYCQG5 | CA SBE Certified #2051043
**NAICS:** 611430, 611710, 541611, 611420, 611519
**PSC:** U099, R499, B599

### 2. Subject Matter Experts & Private Sector (brightlinkconsulting.com/private)
BrightLink builds the digital infrastructure that turns subject matter expertise into scalable businesses:
- Online courses and digital products (curriculum design, production, packaging)
- Online communities (Circle, Skool, custom platforms)
- Marketing ecosystems (email sequences, funnels, lead magnets, launch systems)
- LMS and learning infrastructure (custom-built learning management systems)

**Past client work:** S.A.F.E. (Sexual Assault Forensic Examiners), Protector Nation, Inland Empire SBDC Network, Bravo! Media Academy, Emergence
